reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 10 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

remaining_reasons: The source note has two compact upper rows of small gray marks. The return replaces them with two large irregular gray stains and only tiny lower dots, losing the original second-row compact-mark layout and greatly expanding the upper marks. Restore the source-scale two-row footprint without inventing text or large blotches, keeping the lower paper largely blank.
entries.positive_observation: The yellow mascot retains the upright three-quarter pose facing image right, a rightward gaze and restrained closed-mouth half-smile. The dark olive cap retains a shiny black visor, gold piping/cord and two separated gold front emblems; dark eyebrows remain, with covered hair and no added glasses, moustache or beard. The dark field-grey uniform, light collar/shirt edges, dark tie and small pale collar details remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar without a stalk or clipping. The complete tilted frame, opaque pale grey-beige photographic backing, warm-cream note and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The altered note marks are the separate rejection reason above.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine eye/temple and collar-throat pixels, cap embroidery and note lettering are unresolved at 65x67. The rejection is not based on reading the lettering; it is based on the clearly visible replacement of compact source marks by large stains and loss of the small second-row layout.
